persona: Matter-of-fact. Tried to lodge this claim on the website on the evening of the accident but never got a confirmation email, so is lodging it again; says so if asked.
initial_message: Hi, I need to report some damage to my car. On Saturday 19 September at about 11am I reversed out of a park in the riverside car park in Hokowhitu and hit a concrete planter box. The rear right corner of the bumper is cracked and pushed in. Nobody was hurt and the car still drives normally.

materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo, close-up of the rear right corner of a silver SUV in an outdoor car park beside a low concrete planter box with shrubs. The plastic bumper corner is cracked and pushed inward, with scuffs of grey concrete and a gap where it has come away from the body above the rear wheel. Late morning sun. The frame shows only the bumper corner, the rear wheel and the lower edge of the tail light. No text, no logos, no people.

design.notes: Possible duplicate: the same account submitted a motor claim for an incident on the same day (19 September 2026) on the evening of the accident. The claimant believes it did not go through. It is not counted as a prior claim.

triage.rationale: Otherwise fast: single vehicle, nobody hurt, car drivable, a photo and a complete quote at NZD 1,679.00 including GST, policy on file. But another submitted motor claim from the same account has the same incident date, so staff must check whether it is the same event. It is not a fraud indicator and is not counted as a prior claim. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

prior_claims_12m.basis: The only earlier claim is the possible duplicate, which is not counted again

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (1 January 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2018-01-01, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.

possible_duplicate.basis: Another submitted motor claim from the same account, incident 19 September 2026, submitted 19 September 2026: same family, same day
